audio_caption: A male speaker asks a question about athleticism inside a house. A female speaker responds, stating that they are good at their own sports. Then, a low-energy electronic music begins, setting a thoughtful tone. A male narrator discusses a debate between Simone Biles and her husband about athleticism, quoting Biles as saying her husband could barely do her workout and she crushed his. He then concludes the arguments aside.

The clip begins with a male speaker describing the relationship between Simone Biles and Jonathan Owens as uniquely loving. He mentions their first encounter at a Texans game in 2019, followed by meeting on the dating app Raya in March 2020, with Biles initiating the contact. He quotes Biles saying "I saw him and I was like, oh, he's pretty cute, so I said hi." The speaker then continues to summarize Biles's account of connecting with Owens. Throughout the speech, the speaker maintains an informative and engaging tone. Simultaneously, mellow background music plays, featuring a relaxed and ambient feel, with light rhythmic percussion.

The clip begins with upbeat, playful music, creating a lighthearted mood. It fades to allow a male speaker to talk in an enthusiastic tone. He explains how the subjects of the narrative spent time together during the pandemic because they were able to spend a lot of time off, a rare perk for busy athletes. He tells the listener that they hung out at each other's houses to see if they liked each other and it worked. The man said that they "were just like magnets." Next, another male speaker in a less enthusiastic tone agrees with the sentiment. He added that he "started to want to see her more." He adds that his dog really loved her, then the music returns in the background.

The audio clip features a male narrator speaking in an informative tone, discussing a couple's relationship and engagement. He mentions that the couple "knew early in the relationship" that they wanted to spend more time together, leading to their engagement in 2022, almost two years after meeting on a dating app, which was unsurprising but welcomed by others.  This speech is underpinned by a background music track of unknown genre that accompanies the dialogue without overwhelming it, creating an ambiance conducive to storytelling or narration.

The audio begins with upbeat, poppy music creating a bright mood. Then, a male speaker narrates a news report, relaying an Instagram post where Simone describes accepting an engagement as "the easiest yes". He also mentions Jonathan's excitement about waking up with a fiancée, and his thankfulness for a friend who helped plan the proposal. The music fades to the background as the male speaker continues, then ceases at the end of the clip.

The audio clip begins with a male speaker narrating information about Simone Biles, mentioning "marriage license", writing "I do", and a "courthouse wedding". The speaker has an informational and narrative tone. A week later, the couple had a courthouse wedding, according to the narrative. A female speaker narrates in an Instagram story the reasoning that the wedding will be a destination wedding, so they had to get married in the U.S. legally. The male speaker continues the narrative with Biles updating her name on social media to include her new last name, "Simone Biles Owens". The female speaker reveals that she and her husband weren't done celebrating as they had a destination wedding planned.

The clip starts with a male speaker reporting on a wedding between a gymnast and an NFL safety, which took place in Cabo, Mexico, with 144 guests. He highlights a quote from Simone, saying "Jonathan and I just tuned into each other and blocked everyone out," and later, "I fell in love with him all over." After the couple was pronounced husband and wife, they walked down the aisle to the beat of water drums. The report continues with another quote from Simone, mentioning whales jumping out of the water and a sprinkle of rain for good luck, followed by a full moon, summing it up as "truly the most magical." His tone is informative and enthusiastic.

The audio clip begins with a male speaker, with a casual, informative tone, discussing a special event, highlighting how it was "pinned on her Instagram feed" with the caption "Mr. and Mrs. Owen." He summarizes her showing "highlights of their destination wedding" and quotes her saying her wedding was "better than her first Olympic win," continuing the quote with, "I've never had so much fun in my life...My wedding topped it. It was the greatest feeling ever." The speaker concludes by noting the event happened "while she was taking time off from the sport." Throughout the clip, there is light, cheerful, and upbeat background music, featuring instruments suggestive of a celebratory mood.

The clip begins with a calm male narrator explaining Simone Biles' withdrawal from professional competition due to mental health concerns. He then quotes her acknowledging her bravery in putting herself first. The narrator continues, stating that she suffered from a mental block known as "the twisties" and became an advocate for mental health prioritization. A different female speaker emphasizes that while mental health might not be seen as a physical injury, it can have a significant effect on an individual.  The narrator returns, stating that Biles' two-year hiatus has done wonders for her, as the clip ends. Throughout the audio, there's a very subtle, rhythmic electronic background music, adding a somewhat motivational tone.

The audio clip begins with a male speaker describing a gymnast's comeback and achievements, noting her five medals, including gold medals, and a move named after her; the speaker's tone is informative and enthusiastic. This speech is overlaid on upbeat, inspiring music, possibly cinematic or orchestral.

The audio clip begins with a male speaker describing a story, stating someone received "flack over the fact" they didn't know about their wife until after dating. The speaker continues by summarizing an interview, in which someone learns the magnitude of their wife's influence when "kids would come running to her." The narrator then shifts to the negative reactions of some fans, but acknowledges the "gymnast had never been bothered," and that her husband "appreciated her humility over anything else." Continuing, he mentions that the couple had "spent a lot of time together" and she "was never vocal about her achievements." The speaker then ends with the statement that "their love was based on respect" and that he was proud of that. The clip ends with the male narrator saying "once he caught on though, he made up for it."

The audio begins with sports-themed background music that has an upbeat tone, suggesting a positive or exciting atmosphere. An individual, presumably male, starts speaking, mentioning "Biles" and his "then-girlfriend," summarizing an event where he watched her compete. He then quotes, "What an amazing experience," before continuing to describe his pride and referring to her as "my little champ." The tone sounds admiring and supportive. The speaker continues by noting the enduring "love and support" between the two. Then, the audio segues into mentioning "the NFL star" signing with the "Chicago Bears". The sports music continues playing in the background throughout the speech.

The audio clip begins with a male narrator reading a news report in an informative tone, recounting Simone Biles's reaction to her husband's move and her birthday celebration, including a quote from her husband's message to her. The narrator then questions whether Biles's husband will support her in Paris. Throughout the speech, there is upbeat, motivational instrumental music in the background, which transitions to a more dramatic tone as the narration ends. The music features drums, strings, and other orchestral elements, creating a sense of momentum and anticipation.
